args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Bump to the
2.9.4 fixed release within the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affects <2.9.4).

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (staying on the 2.x line; 3.x would be a major upgrade)

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**

Reviewer: @alex
